## Description
Seismoelectric Sensor (Listening to Marsquakes): By combining data from &#10;&#9;&#9;seismometers and magnetometers, scientists can detect electromagnetic signals generated &#10;&#9;&#9;by marsquakes passing through subsurface aquifers.  This method helps determine aquifer &#10;&#9;&#9;depth, volume, and chemical composition, such as salinity.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;https://earthsky.org/space/water-on-mars-aquifers-marsquakes-seismoelectrical-method/&#10;&#9;&#9;
